summary: Set task #4's due date to 2026-12-31 using the task's "Edit the task" form. My first attempts (typing "2026-12-31" and then picking 00:00 via the field) saved the correct calendar date but the time rendered as 07:15; I then used Kanboard's own jQuery-UI date/time picker to select 31 December 2026 with time 00:00 and saved ("Task updated successfully."). The task page now shows "Due date: 12/31/2026 00:00" — the right date, but displayed in the app's US MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM format, NOT the literal string "2026-12-31". I verified explicitly that the exact ISO string "2026-12-31" appears NEITHER in the live DOM NOR in the raw server response (fetch_source returned 0 matching lines) while "12/31/2026" appears in both, so this instance's date-format setting makes the exact string "2026-12-31" unachievable in its UI. Caveat flagged: the due date is stored as 2026-12-31 (00:00) and displayed as 12/31/2026 00:00.
